caption: The drawing depicts a dress in shades of lavender and light purple, featuring an off-the-shoulder neckline adorned with a decorative circular brooch and trimmed with lace or floral embellishments. The bodice is fitted and tapers to a point at the waist. The sleeves are short and puffed, with large ribbons tied at the shoulders. The skirt is full and consists of two visible layers, both decorated with intricate patterns of embroidery or lace in white, which include floral motifs and zigzag borders. The background is plain, and in the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, unfinished or sketch-style outline of the same dress, showcasing both the front and back view in simple lines without color or detailed decoration.
title: Dress
